R1944.summary: The Dutch chargé d'affaires in Berlin reports that Rosenkrantz does not know why he was dismissed and supposes his cipher was taken and copied by a servant; Lusi says more definitely that the desk holding his cipher was forced open, which is why Schuer was to be sent to Petersburg with a new cipher. So the letter, itself in cipher, reports a compromised codebook.
